title: Inside Busan Station & KTX Bullet Train | Walking Tour in Busan, South Korea
description:
Busan Station is a major transportation hub in South Korea, and it's also a fascinating place to explore. In this walking tour, we'll take a look at the history of the station, its architecture, and its many shops and restaurants. We'll also see some of the unique sights and sounds that make Busan Station such a vibrant and diverse place.

We'll also take a walk through several cars on the KTX bullet train so you can see what it looks like on the train.
